title: Make light source position movable via sliders
description: Add X/Y/Z sliders for the colored point light in cube/ so the user can drag the light around and watch shading change in real time. Move light-pos from a const into the state atom and wire it through shade + draw-light-glow!.

title: Landing page in ClojureScript for vibe exercises
description: Add a sibling shadow-cljs project that renders a landing page with cards for the ball and cube exercises. Mirror the structure of the existing exercises (shadow-cljs.edn, deps.edn, package.json, public/index.html, src/landing/core.cljs). Cards link out to each exercise.

title: Build ClojureScript cube viewer with colored light and orientation sliders
description: Create ./cube directory containing a shadow-cljs project that renders a 3D cube via Three.js with a colored light source. UI exposes slider bars for X/Y/Z rotation of the cube. Self-contained: shadow-cljs.edn, package.json, public/index.html, src/cube/core.cljs.
close_reason: Built cube viewer: shadow-cljs project with 3D cube, warm-orange point light, Lambert shading, and X/Y/Z rotation sliders. Compiles cleanly with 0 warnings.
